interpreterResult.requirementSummary: Sum Cooling Circuit Heights in inches into DX Coil Height, recalculate on edit, and use 0 inches for an empty list.
businessRules: DX Coil Height equals the sum of Cooling Circuit Heights in inches.
A height edit immediately recalculates DX Coil Height.
An empty circuit list produces 0 inches.

reviewResult.rationale: The sum, inches, immediate edit update, empty-list result, and validated-input scope are captured without open questions.
